classification.difficultyReason: Use the triangle sum to solve for x, evaluate the angle expressions, and identify the 90-degree angle needed for the conclusion.

content.prompt: Show that this shape is a right-angled triangle.

spec.description: Unshaded scalene triangle with a left vertex, upper vertex and lower-right vertex. Three interior arcs; no supplied right-angle marker. Source grey outlines are rendered in house black.
spec.mathematics: Interior angles are x, (2x+26) degrees and (2x-6) degrees. Coordinates reproduce the illustrated topology without asserting measured lengths.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied angle expressions are visible; numerical angles and the right-angle conclusion belong to the answers.

answer.short: $x=32^{\circ}$. The angles are $32^{\circ}$, $90^{\circ}$ and $58^{\circ}$, so the triangle is right-angled.
answer.worked:
Angles in a triangle sum to $180^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{align*}x+(2x+26^{\circ})+(2x-6^{\circ})&=180^{\circ}\\5x+20^{\circ}&=180^{\circ}\\5x&=160^{\circ}\\x&=32^{\circ}\\2x+26^{\circ}&=2(32^{\circ})+26^{\circ}=90^{\circ}\\2x-6^{\circ}&=2(32^{\circ})-6^{\circ}=58^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
One angle is $90^{\circ}$, so the triangle is right-angled.
